qualification: negative/control-free diagnostic evidence only; P5 and final GOAL A–H acceptance remain pending
findings: Across 68.542839 wall seconds, /clock advanced 19.864000 simulation seconds (RTF 0.289804).

Estimator flags and land-detected messages had source timestamp increments near 1.0 simulated second and receipt intervals near 3.4 wall seconds; callback source age stayed near zero (maximum 0.136 s and 0.088 s respectively). The canonical 3.0 s wall receipt gate therefore expires before the next normally paced update.

After the 64-sample mapper fit window filled, exact reconstructed wall-per-simulation slopes ranged 3.242629–5.292608, inside configured [0.1,10]. No clock regression occurred. 27 partial-window startup fits were above 10 while the ring held only 5–31 points; bridge detail reported no odometry-time error in this run.

The no-control probe found VIO/map preconditions ready but did not pass the five-second PX4 freshness window. It made no EnableOffboard call and sent no navigation goal; PX4 remained disarmed and bridge DISABLED.
limitations: The 3.0 s estimator_flags/land_detected wall-age limits caused the 5 s telemetry stability gate to fail; this no-control run cannot be counted as a flight.

The callback timestamps show about 1.0 s simulated updates arriving about every 3.4 s wall time, with source age near zero at arrival. This strongly supports low simulation RTF plus PX4 publication cadence as the freshness cause; it does not prove there were no isolated transport losses.

The 27 offline out-of-range fits occurred only in partial startup windows before the 64-sample fit ring filled; no full-window fit exceeded configured bounds and the bridge report recorded no odometry_time_error. The #390 takeoff-time mapper exception remains unexplained.
No obstacle, movement goal, body-envelope clearance, truth error, fault injection, repeated cold-start suite, frozen acceptance threshold or ten-minute load test was performed.
The PX4 ULog contains an internal groundtruth dataset; project ROS topic list and bridge info show no debug_truth input in this run. The dataset was not used by the project navigation/control graph.
next_step: Measure how to raise full-stack RTF above the 0.333 threshold implied by 1.0 simulated-second PX4 status cadence and the unchanged 3.0 s wall-age gate; test available GPU acceleration/runtime scheduling with the same no-control paired probe before changing any canonical threshold.
